claim: Reassignment proposals come from floor-core proposeReassignment and are applied only through applyReassign.
Reassignment reads an empty section id as no section (floor-core then says no_one_on_shift when nobody is listed), proposes each table once, and applyReassign moves a table at most once.
verify: grep -q 'sectionId: holders.sectionOf.get(tableId) || null' apps/api-gateway/src/floor/floor-admin.service.ts && grep -q 'const movedTables = new Set<string>();' apps/api-gateway/src/floor/floor-admin.service.ts && grep -q 'no_one_on_shift' apps/api-gateway/src/floor/floor-reassign.spec.ts
